principle: Use small typed registries linked by stable IDs. Do not force unrelated lifecycle states into one universal record.

registries.name: sources
registries.purpose: Research or runtime evidence sources and provenance.
registries.state: source index exists; machine-readable schema pending

registries.name: claims
registries.purpose: Atomic factual/empirical/inferred claims with epistemic class, scope, freshness and conflicting evidence.

registries.name: findings
registries.purpose: Synthesized conclusions derived from one or more claims.

registries.name: failures
registries.purpose: Normalized failures, signatures, recurrence, causes, regressions and repairs.

registries.name: improvements
registries.purpose: Actionable improvement candidates; existing IMP records remain the human/action projection.

registries.name: hypotheses
registries.purpose: Falsifiable proposed explanations or expected improvements.

registries.name: eval_suites
registries.purpose: Versioned collections of eval cases and governance metadata.

registries.name: eval_runs
registries.purpose: Immutable results linking exact system/model/tool/config versions to eval outcomes.

registries.name: decisions
registries.purpose: Architectural/product/policy decisions and rejected alternatives; ADR compatible.

registries.name: capabilities
registries.purpose: Provider-neutral model/tool/component capability definitions and measured evidence.

registries.name: research_radar
registries.purpose: External ecosystem developments screened for material Agent OS impact.

registries.name: questions
registries.purpose: Unresolved questions, uncertainty, evidence gaps and research queues.

registries.name: prior_art
registries.purpose: Evaluated open-source projects with ADOPT/WRAP/BORROW/REJECT/DEFER/INVESTIGATE decisions and separate evidence dimensions; consulted before significant design decisions.
